result.title: Don't Miss the Forest for the Trees: Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition with Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototypes
result.summary: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition is evaluated almost exclusively on flat leaf labels, which leaves open whether a representation also grounds the broader concepts that contain an action in skeleton motion. We find that strong leaf alignment does not carry over to them: when ancestor concepts are scored directly under independent decoding, eight flat methods with 57.86-73.29% mean leaf Top-1 reach only 6.15-31.21% mean full-path accuracy across four NTU RGB+D splits. We propose the Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototype ($H^2SP$) framework, which represents every node of an action taxonomy in the Lorentz model of hyperbolic space. First, instead of learning a free vector per node, $H^2SP$ synthesizes hierarchy-aware prototypes by recursive parent-child geodesic interpolation under a single tree-wide gate. Second, tangent-space semantic and distributional alignment on seen classes anchor the leaf prototypes in skeleton motion. Third, a soft entailment-cone regularizer encourages directional parent-child inclusion, propagating this motion grounding to ancestor concepts. We evaluate hierarchical concept prediction under independent and cascade decoding, and transfer to an alternative taxonomy without retraining. Across the four splits, $H^2SP$ attains the best mean independent and cascade full-path accuracy among the evaluated methods, at a comparable leaf Top-1 of 72.40%. Transferred to the alternative taxonomy, it outperforms both flat baselines and the same-tree Euclidean control across every split and decoding mode, indicating that its concept-level correspondence extends beyond the training taxonomy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出零样本骨架动作识别仅评测扁平叶标签、其对齐难以迁移到上层概念，提出在双曲 Lorentz 空间为动作分类树每个节点构建语义原型 $H^2SP$：以父子测地插值和单一树级门控合成原型，再用切空间对齐与蕴含锥正则把骨架运动接地传播到祖先概念，并在 NTU 四个划分及跨分类体系迁移上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 骨架动作识别与分层概念预测不在 VLM 推理主线内，但其「子节点原型由父节点插值合成、以方向性蕴含约束组织层级」的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态的层级抽象与表示几何组织提供可供核查的线索。
